metadata.description: Agent-harness knowledge base as installable Claude Code plugins

plugins.name: agent-tooling
plugins.description: Agent-facing tooling methodology skill: contract-first CLI/MCP design from existing specs, the agent CLI contract (format modes, typed exit codes, dry-run, optimistic concurrency, patch-mode), tool-surface sizing, and blind two-arm measurement on a weak model.

plugins.name: java-qa
plugins.description: Java QA automation methodology skill + subagent: test design, contract testing (Pact/SCC), Testcontainers, schema evolution, test-pyramid & CI-lane decisions.

plugins.name: product-analytics
plugins.description: Product/data analytics methodology skill: metric reconciliation, funnel analysis, SQL review, definitions-before-queries, grain and time discipline, publish gate.

plugins.name: sysadmin-sre
plugins.description: Sysadmin/SRE methodology skill: incident triage, Kubernetes manifest and Terraform plan review, DNS and TLS debugging, read-only default with evidence and blast-radius gates.

plugins.name: video-color
plugins.description: Video color methodology skill: source trust classification, normalization, shot matching, mask secondaries, camera profiling (ACES IDT), HDR→SDR tone mapping, range/precision gates, persistent grade plan.
